answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the velvet graph. Re-attestations are stored in vault and glacier lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 586 impostors cost 330 times the honest price and take 27 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
